summary: No new receipt this turn; I recorded one reachability boundary that the repair picture needed. Although an installed snapshot does carry the configuration, a leader sends a snapshot only when the follower lacks entries the leader has already compacted — and a node that lost its configuration this way has a complete log, since the loss comes from skipping entries rather than missing them — so no snapshot is ever sent to such a node in any of these scenarios. The snapshot path therefore repairs new or behind nodes, while a stale-but-complete node is repaired only by an operator restart without the flag or by a later configuration entry from a correctly configured leader, both of which are executed and cited. Nothing else changed: the trigger, mechanism, consequence classes, safety violation, progress losses, client-contract consequence, controls, reproducibility, negative results and citation audit all stand as recorded, with no open gaps and no pending receipts.
